d: Long, straight crimson hair with blunt bangs frames a mature face with almond-shaped, teal eyes. The build is slender and athletic, dressed in a black sleeveless mini-dress with a high side slit and a brown utility belt holding three teal potions. A wide-brimmed, pointed black witch's hat with a teal underside completes the look, paired with black high-heeled pumps and a small flame flickering above a gloved hand. BODY COLOR: fair LEGS: plantigrade with human-style feet
